build_command: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; npm run build -- --base=/keeper/; replace index.html APP_BASE_PATH placeholder with /keeper; tar dist files
validation: 10 focused Vitest tests passed; TypeScript check, targeted ESLint and Vite build passed
baseline_storage: browser localStorage, scoped by base path
api_scope: all CPA API keys; enabled Codex identities with matching subscription plan
estimation: sample standard cost / summed remaining-fraction decline; total=per-account estimate*count, remaining=per-account estimate*sum remaining fractions
